SessionStart.command: if command -v brot >/dev/null 2>&1; then brot hook antigravity session-start; else printf '{}\n'; fi

hooks.command: if command -v brot >/dev/null 2>&1; then brot hook antigravity post-tool-use; else printf '{}\n'; fi

Stop.command: if command -v brot >/dev/null 2>&1; then brot hook antigravity stop; else printf '{}\n'; fi
